'''Niful''' was a [[moon]]-sized [[asteroid]] located in the [[Aniras belt]]. It had a thin, yet breathable [[atmosphere]] and a surface covered in sticky mud. After meeting [[Darth Sidious]] on [[Exegol]], [[Ben Solo|Kylo Ren]] went to Niful, where he entrusted his shattered [[Kylo Ren's helmet|helmet]] to the [[Symeong]] metalsmith [[Albrekh]].<ref name="TROS Junior Novel">''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: A Junior Novel]]''</ref>
